description: One record per product, search result, or bestseller entry, plus explicit error rows. Fields include ASIN/parent ASIN, price/list price/coupon/deal, rating/review count, BSR, seller/buybox, offers, availability, variants, images/videos/specs/A+ text, top review snippets, marketplace, URL, and scrapedAt. Empty fields are omitted.

products.description: Dataset containing product, searchResult, bestseller, and error records.
